records.question: Eighty-five cans were collected. LaDonna picked up 25 cans. Prikya picked up twice as many times as many cans as LaDonna. Yoki picked up the rest of the cans. How many cans did Yoki pick up?
records.response:
Prikya picked up twice as many cans as LaDonna, so Prikya picked up 25*2 = 50 cans.
Together, LaDonna and Prikya picked up 25+50 = 75 cans.
Yoki picked up the rest of the cans, so Yoki picked up 85-75 = 10 cans.
#### 10

records.question: Saheed made four times as much money as Kayla. Kayla made $30 less than Vika. Vika made $84. How many dollars did Saheed make?
Saheed made four times as much money as Kayla. Kayla made $30 less than Vika. Vika made $84. How many dollars did Saheed make?
records.response:
Kayla made 84-30 = 54 dollars.
Saheed made 4*54 = 216 dollars.
#### 216
